subject: Regarding Your Recent Job Application
body: Dear [Applicant Name], Thank you for submitting your job application for the Marketing Coordinator position at our company. We appreciate your interest in joining our team. Our hiring team is currently reviewing all applications and will be in touch with you within the next two weeks to provide an update on the status of your application. In the meantime, if you have any questions or need further information, please feel free to reach out to us. Best regards, [Company Name] HR Team
